get.description: Anyone may read the course page, with or without a token (MDRS-122): its description and programme (week and lesson titles, types, schedule, length, müderris). Lesson content — `meetingUrl`, `agenda`, `kaynak` and resource `url` — is sent only to a caller holding `view_details` (the enrolled talebe, the müderris, the köşk manager); for everyone else, PENDING included, those keys are absent and `contentLocked` is true. A content read by anyone who is neither enrolled nor a müderris of the course is recorded in `audit_log` (MDRS-103). A caller with no token gets the same filtered body, and 404 for a draft, a hidden course, or any course of an unlisted köşk.

get.description: Open to callers with no token, like the course page (MDRS-122), and filtered the same way: `meetingUrl`, `agenda`, `kaynak` and `cancelReason` are sent only to a caller holding `view_details` (the enrolled talebe, the müderris, the köşk manager); for everyone else, PENDING included, those keys are absent and `contentLocked` is true. `status` is derived from the clock and the cancellation, never stored: CANCELLED once cancelled, else ENDED after the session's length (60 minutes when it has none), LIVE while it runs, SCHEDULED before. `meetingUrl` is null for a cancelled or finished session. `previous` and `next` are the neighbouring live sessions in programme order, cancelled ones skipped. A content read by anyone who is neither enrolled nor a müderris is recorded in `audit_log`, as on `GET /courses/:id` (MDRS-158).

404.description: No such course or session, the session is not a live one, or the course is a draft, hidden or in an unlisted köşk to this caller (LESSON_NOT_FOUND, COURSE_NOT_FOUND).

The week holding `startDate` is "Hafta 1"; each session goes into the week of its date, and a missing week is created as "Hafta N". Bumps the course version like the other session-level writes (MDRS-109).

A COURSE ban is the course's müderris's and above; a KOSK ban, placed from this course, is the köşk nazımı's and above. Barring someone already barred in that scope returns the standing ban. The reason is kept for those who see and lift bans and never sent to the talebe.

ownerId.description: Who created the köşk. Grants nothing since MDRS-126 — see managerIds. Null for a caller with no token (MDRS-160): a person's id is not for the public.

managerName.description: The name of the köşk's oldest manager, shown as "Köşk nazımı" (MDRS-160). Null when that person has no name on file. Open to everyone, signed in or not.

isPrivate.description: Unlisted (MDRS-122): in no list or search, opened by its link to signed-in callers only, and every enrollment in its courses waits for approval.

muderrisIsImam.description: That müderris is the course's imam.

inCollection.description: Whether the caller has the deck in their collection

accessible.description: False for a caller who is neither a talebe, a müderris nor a manager of the köşk: the köşk page then leaves the block out.

tags.description: At most 10 distinct, non-blank tags of up to 40 characters

tags.description: At most 10 distinct, non-blank tags of up to 40 characters

createdBy.description: The SYSTEM_ADMIN who created it. Null for a caller with no token (MDRS-160)

headMuderrisName.description: The başmüderris's display name; null with none, or while that person has never signed in.

nextSessionAt.description: The earliest session of the course that is still ahead; null when none is scheduled. The meeting link is never part of this response.

kosks.description: Only the köşks the medrese has a listed course in

handle.description: Unique, URL-safe: lower-case letters, digits and inner hyphens, 2–60 characters

version.description: Optimistic-concurrency token. Send it back with PUT /courses/:id and PATCH /lessons/:id; a stale value is refused with 409.

scheduledAt.description: When the live session starts (type = LIVE).

meetingUrl.description: External meeting link (Meet/Zoom/Jitsi…), https only (MDRS-111). The platform is resolved from the URL on the client.

agenda.description: Müzakere akışı — agenda steps shown to students.

scope.description: COURSE bars the talebe from this course alone; KOSK from every course of its köşk, and they may not apply again. KOSK is the köşk nazımı's and above.

reason.description: Read by whoever sees the ban and by whoever lifts it; never sent to the talebe. Required, and not blank.

name.description: Null when the account never signed in to tedrisat.

extendedFromCourseId.description: For a KOSK ban widened from a course: that course. Null otherwise.

bannedRole.description: The role the banner acted in (KOSK_NAZIM, MUDERRIS, DERS_NAZIR, MEDRESE_NAZIR, MEDRESE_BASMUDERRIS, MEDARIS_NAZIM or SYSTEM_ADMIN). The client words it.

viewerMayLift.description: Whether the caller's kademe reaches the ban's: false means the row shows no lift button (the server refuses with 403 all the same).

viewerMayExtend.description: Whether the caller may widen this course ban to the whole köşk: a köşk nazımı or above, on an open course ban with no open köşk ban for the person.

recentCount.description: Open bans placed in the last 24 hours.

reason.example: Talebeyle görüşüldü; celse âdâbına uyacağına söz verdi.
reason.description: Kept with the ban and the lifter's name. Required, and not blank.

dueAt.description: When the card is due again (MDRS-165); null for a card nobody rated, which is due now if it is LEARNING.

intervalDays.description: The days between the last two reviews; 0 before the first.

dueCount.description: How many of `cards` are repeats that are due.

newCount.description: How many of `cards` are cards the caller has not started.

ReviewRating.description: How hard the talebe found the card (MDRS-165). HARD and MEDIUM keep it LEARNING, EASY masters it; each sets when it is due again.

status.description: The state to record. Required unless `rating` is sent; with a rating the server derives the state and the next review time and ignores this.

rating.description: How hard the talebe found the card (MDRS-165). HARD and MEDIUM keep it LEARNING, EASY masters it; each sets when it is due again.

row.description: Row number in the uploaded file (1-based)

tags.description: Empty for everyone but the author.

source.description: OWN: the caller wrote it. COLLECTION: somebody else did.

collectionKind.description: Where a deck of somebody else's comes from; null for the caller's own decks.

inCollection.description: The caller has the deck in the collection.

contextTitle.description: The course, köşk or medrese the deck belongs to, by name; null for a public deck.

muderrisName.description: The course's first müderris, for a course deck.

newCount.description: Cards the caller has not started.

dueCount.description: Cards waiting for a repeat now (MDRS-165): started, and their review time has come, or they never got one while learning.

addedSinceCollectedCount.description: Cards written after the caller collected the deck; always 0 for the caller's own.

cardType.description: What the deck's cards are; fixed once the deck exists.

active.description: Whether the caller has a feed URL. The URL itself cannot be shown again: only its hash is stored.

createdAt.description: When the current URL was issued; null without one.

url.description: The feed as https — for Google Calendar's "From URL".

webcalUrl.description: The same feed as webcal — Apple Calendar subscribes to it.

type.description: What happened. The sentence is not stored: the client words it from this key and `params`, in the reader's language.

targetType.description: What the notification leads to. For a SESSION, `params.courseId` names its course.

params.description: Flat values the sentence is filled from (course title, session time, reason, who or where it came from).

readAt.description: When the caller read it; null while unread.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page. Opaque.

unread.description: Unread — the bell and the tab.

updated.description: How many were unread and are read now.

weekNumber.description: The week the session sits in.

durationMinutes.description: Length in minutes; null when the müderris set none.

status.description: Derived from the clock and the cancellation, as on `GET /courses/:courseId/sessions/:sessionId`.

meetingUrl.description: The meeting link; null when none was added, and always null once the session is cancelled or over. Only an enrolled caller receives this response, so the link is theirs to read.

displayName.description: Null when the person has not signed in since names were kept

grantedBySelf.description: The caller gave this role to themselves

course.description: Present when the scope is a course

scopeCount.description: In how many scopes the role is held

permission.description: A catalog code; null when the grant is a group

permissions.description: Every catalog code the caller holds in any scope

role.description: Null for scopes where the caller holds a grant but no role

displayName.description: Null when nobody holds the role or the directory is not reachable

name.description: Null when the account never signed in to tedrisat.

role.description: The role the hider holds or held where the item sits (KOSK_NAZIM, MEDRESE_BASMUDERRIS, MEDRESE_NAZIR, MUDERRIS, DERS_NAZIR); null for SYSTEM_ADMIN or when none is on record. The client words it.

title.description: The hidden thing's own title or name.

courseId.description: The course a week or a session belongs to.

weekNumber.description: Of a week, and of the week a session is in.

weekCount.description: Of a course: its live weeks.

sessionCount.description: Of a week: its live sessions.

studentCount.description: Of a course: its enrolled talebe.

total.description: All hidden items matching, not just this page.

courses.description: Courses that go with it (a köşk's).

recordings.description: Lesson recordings; 0 until recordings are stored.

nazirOf.description: Medreses the caller is nazır of. Always empty until tedrisat stores medrese nazırs.
